bullet: Flush timer from the first event (`F32.flush-delay`).
script:
control-agent-server restart --config-json "{\"webhooks\": [{\"base_url\": \"$WH/qa-f32-d\", \"event_buffer_size\": 100, \"flush_delay\": 6}]}"
control-agent-server exec --timeout 40 --expect-output QA_F32_TIMER_VERIFIED --save F32.flush-delay/timed-probe -- .venv/bin/python - <<'PYTIMER'
import json
import os
import time
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

sink = Path(os.environ["AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN"]) / "fixtures/webhooks.jsonl"
with httpx.Client(base_url=os.environ["AGENT_SERVER_URL"],
                  headers={"X-Session-API-Key": os.environ["SESSION_API_KEY"]}, timeout=20) as http:
    workspace = Path(os.environ["AGENT_SERVER_VERIFY_RUN"]) / "fixtures" / "qa-f32-timer-workspace"
    workspace.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    t0 = time.monotonic()
    response = http.post("<redacted:session-cookie>", json={"agent_settings": {"agent_kind": "openhands", "llm": {"model": "openai/qa-placeholder", "api_key": "qa-placeholder",
                         "base_url": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1", "num_retries": 0}, "tools": []},
                         "workspace": {"kind": "LocalWorkspace", "working_dir": str(workspace)}, "autotitle": False})
    response.raise_for_status()
    cid = response.json()["id"]
    path = "/qa-f32-d/events/" + cid.replace("-", "")

    def deliveries():
        return [json.loads(line) for line in sink.read_text().splitlines() if json.loads(line)["path"] == path] if sink.exists() else []

    time.sleep(3)
    http.post(f"<redacted:session-cookie>/{cid}/events", json={"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "QA_F32_TIMER"}],
              "run": False}).raise_for_status()
    assert not deliveries(), "delivery happened before 6-second timer"
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 15
    while not deliveries() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(0.1)
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - t0
    captured = deliveries()
    assert len(captured) == 1, len(captured)
    assert 5 <= elapsed <= 8, elapsed
    payload = captured[0]["body"]
    assert "QA_F32_TIMER" in json.dumps(payload), payload
    assert any(event.get("key") == "full_state" for event in payload), payload
    print(json.dumps({"cid": cid, "elapsed_seconds": round(elapsed, 3), "batches": len(captured),
                      "has_snapshot": True, "has_second_message": True}))
    print("QA_F32_TIMER_VERIFIED")
